Frost Nymphs are frost nymphs found in the Frozen Glade in the Howling Fjord. They sometimes throw snowballs at each other. They are not involved with any quests, but are notable for being non-corrupted nymphs.

The Frostblade Shrine is located at the peak of Frostblade Peak in Howling Fjord. Players can meditate at the shrine to cleanse themselves of their Inner Turmoil and lighten their soul with a three-minute Slow Fall buff which can be used to BASE jump off the peak back in to Howling Fjord to the south or into the Grizzly Hills to the north. To reach the shrine, take the path in between Camp Winterhoof and Fort Wildervar leading north to the Grizzly Hills. To the east is a marked, but not all that noticeable path leading up to the peak.

Frostbrood Vanquishers are frost wyrms made from the reanimated bones of dragon carcasses excavated by the Scourge in Icecrown. Death knight players can summon one during the quest An End To All Things... by using the Horn of the Frostbrood.
Frostberries can be found on Frostberry Bushes littering the grounds of Coldarra for Nuts for Berries.

Frost vrykul are a variant of vrykul. They look like vrykul, except their skin is blue and layered with frost. Frost vrykul may be a race, but the Ymirjar frost vrykul may be a frozen form of undead unrelated to the all-female hyldnir vrykul.

Frostbite Bullets were sold by General Goods vendors in Northrend for a stack.

__NOTOC__ Fringe Engineer Tezzla is a goblin quest giver located on a small platform hung with Horde banners over Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. She is the developer of infra-green technology, allowing the small base she operates from to be completely concealed from the eyes of the Lich King despite being surrounded by his minions and scanning devices. Players who have not been attuned (by Chief Engineer Copperclaw) are likewise unable to detect its presence.
Frostberry Bushes can be found throughout Coldarra in the Borean Tundra.

Frostburn is the mastery for Frost mages. It is a unique gameplay mechanic for frost mages that increases the damage done against frozen targets as well as increased the damage done by the mage's Water Elemental.

Frost Specialization is one of the passive specialization bonuses gained by a Mage when specializing into the Frost-tree at level 10. It simply increases the damage of the Mage's Frost-spells, which "ensures" that the Mage will be using Frost-spells instead of Arcane- and Fire-spells, thus making it an Frost-Mage. It also increases the damage of Frostbolt.

Hell's Heart I Stab at Thee is an exploration achievement earned for defeating the Whale Shark in Vashj'ir. This achievement was all but impossible without a group, for the Whale Shark one-shotted anything it melees; however, it can be easily done solo by a level 100 character as of Warlords of Draenor.

Fronkle the Disturbed is a rare goblin mob who stands on the nose of a crashed bomber at Land's End Beach in Tanaris. He carries a :Diamond-Tipped Cane and, much like the other nearby goblins, has apparently gone insane. He and Marvon Rivetseeker were friends.

From Darkness, Comes Light is a priest talent, available at level 45. It consists of two distinct effects: Surge of Light and Surge of Darkness. The former is helpful for priests who are healing and/or using Smite, while the latter is useful only to Shadow priests.

Before the War of the Ancients, Tyrande Whisperwind took the frostsaber cub Ash'alah as a companion. 4,000 years ago, Tyrande rescued the frostsaber queen Shy-Rotam from ice giants, granting an eternal alliance between the night elves and the frostsabers. Rivern Frostwind continues to protect her and the frostsabers from the frostmaul giants by sending Alliance heroes against them. Their ferocious appetite earned them the nickname "Dragon Belly" in the night elf language. Night elves raise frostsaber cubs from infancy, forging lifelong bonds of trust between rider and beas

Frostsaber Rock is a large jutting tor in the northern part of Winterspring. At the very apex of Frostsaber Rock stands Rivern Frostwind of the Wintersaber Trainers. He offers friends of the Alliance to work for him, and in exchange he will teach them how to tame and ride one of the beautiful beasts.

The Frostmane tribe (or clan) are a tribe of ice trolls that inhabit Dun Morogh and constantly fight a guerrilla war against the dwarves. In recent times, they have welcomed the trogg invasion of the dwarven lands, and are content to let the two sides fight it out whilst they sit and wait for an opportunistic moment to take back their lands. They can be found throughout Dun Morogh, notably in Shimmer Ridge, Frostmane Retreat and Frostmane Hovel. Their former capital, Frostmane Hold, was taken over by troggs.

Frostguard is a main-hand sword with a chance on hit to slow your target. Frostguard is one of the few weapons found in both Warcraft III and WoW. Frostguard was first discovered in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne by Rexxar. Its previous owner was a footman who was the sole survivor of the naga attack on the human settlement.

Frostmaul Giants are ice giants found in southeastern Winterspring where they have been terrorizing the frostsabers for several millennia. 4,000 years ago Tyrande Whisperwind saved the frostsaber queen, Shy-Rotam, from the rampaging giants.

Frostwolf Graveyard (abbreviated FW or FW GY) is a graveyard located just north of Frostwolf Village. At the beginning of a battle, this graveyard is controlled by the Frostwolf Clan. The flag controlling the graveyard is directly north of the Frostwolf Village gate; however, the spawn area is northeast of the Frostwolf Village gate. This graveyard is guarded by Commander Malgor. Unlike all other graveyard flags, the flag of this graveyard is located in relatively open plain. It does not offer any shelters for attackers or defenders. As of patch 2.3, Commander Malgor has been removed. The graveyard is now only guarded by the four flag guards.
This is the final graveyard Alliance people can capture before hitting Drek'Thar and his Warmasters. It is a very strategic point for many Alliance PVP members.

Frostwolf Battleguards are orcs, tauren, and Forsaken found in Alterac Valley.
Frostwolf Bowmen are orcs and tauren found in Alterac Valley.
Frostwolf Legionnaires are orcs located in Alterac Valley. They are accompanied by Frost Wolf Bloodhounds. They appear during the Heritage of Draenor questline at Frostwolf Village.
The Frostwolf Explosives Expert was found in the Iceblood Garrison of Alterac Valley.
Frostmane Belt is a quest reward from Eliminate the Resistance.
Frostmaul Tumblers are ice giants found between Owl Wing Thicket and Dun Mandarr in Winterspring.
Frostilicus's Hide is a quest reward from Damn You, Frostilicus.
Frostwarden Warriors are frost vrykul located in the Frostwing Halls in Icecrown Citadel.
Frostwarden Sorceresses are frost vrykul located in the Frostwing Halls in Icecrown Citadel.
Frostwarden Handlers are frost vrykul located in the Frost Queen's Lair in Icecrown Citadel.
Frostwing Whelps are dragon whelps found in the Frost Queen's Lair in Icecrown Citadel.
Frostmane Builders are ice troll mobs that can be found at Frostmane Retreat in Dun Morogh. They appear to serve the role of peons, chopping wood and working on buildings.
Frostmane Warriors are ice troll mobs that can be found at Frostmane Retreat in Dun Morogh. They are protecting their leader, Battok the Berserker.

Frostmane Scouts are ice troll mobs that can be found at the Frostmane Front in Dun Morogh. They are fighting with the dwarves of Kharanos. During the Legion Invasions, some of them were killed by the demons.

Frostmane Raiders are ice troll mobs found riding Stolen Rams in the Tundrid Hills in Dun Morogh. They also appear at Amberstill Ranch during It's Raid Night Every Night. The ones at Amberstill do not drop anything.
Frostmane Scavengers are ice troll mobs that can be found at Frostmane Front in Dun Morogh. They are searching the area for gears, which Razzle Sprysprocket needs to repair two steam tanks.
Frostfang is a frost wolf pet of Heksi, the stable master at K3 in the Storm Peaks.
Frostmane Witch Doctors are ice trolls located at the Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh during the Blood in the Snow scenario.
